create_registry: create a Registry instance named BACKBONE to manage name to object mappings for custom modules
register_class_as_decorator: register a class under a name using the Registry register method as a decorator
register_class_as_function: register a class under a name using the Registry register method as a function call
get_registered_object: get a registered object by name from the Registry and resolve lazy registered objects automatically
register_lazy_object: register a LazyRegisterable object with a module path and optional name for lazy dynamic import
